warning: Cluster IDs are specific to this fitted model. Names describe observed cluster averages, not causal effects or definitive classifications of individuals or economies. The digital-safety dimension reflects the available phone-protection measure only.

0.name: Digitally Active, Safety Gap
0.description: High account access and digital financial usage, but a low phone-protection score.

1.name: Connected and Digitally Included
1.description: High connectivity, account access, digital financial usage, and phone-protection scores.

2.name: Connected, Financially Excluded
2.description: High connectivity and phone-protection scores, but no observed account access or digital financial usage.

3.name: Multi-Dimensional Inclusion Gap
3.description: Relatively low connectivity, with no observed account access, digital financial usage, or phone protection.

4.name: Access Without Digital Usage
4.description: Observed account access, but no observed digital financial payment usage; the phone-protection score is intermediate.
